title.hanzi: 左边那个红色的是我的
title.pinyin: Zuǒbiān nàge hóngsè de shì wǒ de
title.english: The red one on the left is mine

instruction.hanzi: 给下面的词语选择对应的图片
instruction.english: Match the pictures with the words.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shì nǐ de ma?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.pinyin: Bú shì wǒ de. Shì wǒ bàba de.
dialogue.english: No, it isn't. It's my father's.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 这是今天早上的报纸吗?
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì jīntiān zǎoshang de bàozhǐ ma?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你听,是不是送报纸的来了?
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, shì bu shì sòng bàozhǐ de lái le?
dialogue.english: Listen — is that the newspaper delivery man?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 我看一下。不是,是送牛奶的。
dialogue.pinyin: Wǒ kàn yíxià. Bú shì, shì sòng niúnǎi de.
dialogue.english: Let me see. No, it's the milkman.

newWords.english: used after a verb, indicating an act or an attempt

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 这是我和我丈夫的,旁边那个小的房间是我女儿的。
dialogue.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ hé wǒ zhàngfu de, pángbiān nàge xiǎo de fángjiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér de.
dialogue.english: It's my husband's and mine. The small one beside it is my daughter's.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 你女儿的房间真漂亮!都是粉色的。
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ'ér de fángjiān zhēn piàoliang! Dōu shì fěnsè de.
dialogue.english: Your daughter's room is so pretty! It's all pink.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 是啊,粉色是我女儿最喜欢的颜色。
dialogue.pinyin: Shì a, fěnsè shì wǒ nǚ'ér zuì xǐhuan de yánsè.
dialogue.english: Yes. Pink is her favorite color.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.pinyin: Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de bēizi le ma?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.hanzi: 这里有几个杯子,哪个是你的?
dialogue.pinyin: Zhèli yǒu jǐ ge bēizi, nǎge shì nǐ de?
dialogue.english: Here are a few cups. Which one is yours?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.hanzi: 左边那个红色的是我的。
dialogue.pinyin: Zuǒbian nàge hóngsè de shì wǒ de.
dialogue.english: The red one on the left is mine.

explanation.hanzi: 代词、形容词、动词等跟"的"组成一个短语,相当于省略了中心语的名词短语。
explanation.english: "的" can follow a pronoun, adjective, or verb to form a phrase equivalent to a nominal phrase with its headword omitted.

examples.hanzi: 这本书不是我的。(= 我的书)
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū bú shì wǒ de.
examples.english: This book isn't mine. (= my book)

examples.hanzi: 这个杯子是昨天买的。(= 昨天买的杯子)
examples.pinyin: Zhège bēizi shì zuótiān mǎi de.
examples.english: This cup was bought yesterday. (= the cup bought yesterday)

examples.hanzi: 这块手表是你的吗?(= 你的手表)
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo shì nǐ de ma?
examples.english: Is this watch yours? (= your watch)

explanation.hanzi: "一下"用在动词后面,表示一次短暂的动作,相当于动词的重叠式 AA(见第8课),宾语可以省略。
explanation.english: "一下" follows a verb to indicate a short action — similar to the reduplicative form (AA) of the verb (see Lesson 8). The object can be omitted.

explanation.hanzi: "真+形容词"表示感叹的语气,意思是的确、实在。
explanation.english: "真 + adjective" expresses an exclamatory mood, meaning "really, indeed".

examples.pinyin: Nǐ nǚ'ér de fángjiān zhēn piàoliang!
examples.english: Your daughter's room is really pretty!

prompt.english: Answer the questions based on the dialogs.

singleComponentChars.etymology: The original form is an image of a hand. It means "hand".
"丈" originally referred to an old person holding a walking stick. Now it is a unit of length.
"夫" originally referred to an adult man. Now it usually means "a man or husband in a family".
